Text-to-speech with explicit MP3 response format

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\CreateSpeechRequest;
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->speech(new \Liter\Llm\CreateSpeechRequest(model: "tts-1-hd",
input: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.",
voice: "nova",
responseFormat: "mp3",
speed: 1.0));
var_dump($result);
```
